title: Thread a tax_rate through cart and checkout
prompt: Add tax support across two files. In cart.py, total() must accept a tax_rate (default 0.0) and apply it. In checkout.py, checkout() must accept a tax_rate and pass it through to total(). checkout(items, tax_rate=0.1) must return the taxed total. Both files must change.
optimal_steps_note: Minimum tool calls with run_verify available: one write per allowed file, one verify, one finish. Files are seeded into the prompt, so reads are not required. The verify-off arm has a floor one lower.
